Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.description: Represents a quotation generated by the Quotation Builder.

quotationId.description: Unique identifier for the Quotation entity.

clientDetails.description: JSON string containing the client's details (name, company, address).

products.description: JSON string representing the products included in the quotation.

pricing.description: JSON string representing the pricing details for the quotation items.

totals.description: JSON string representing the subtotal, GST, and grand total.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the quotation was created.

createdBy.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the quotation.

status.description: The current status of the quotation.

subject.description: The subject line of the quotation.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and system role.

role.description: The assigned access level for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

/quotations/{quotationId}.description: Stores individual quotation records. Admin (deeqasa@admin.in) has full access.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores role-based profile information. Users can access their own, Admin has full access.
